profile.headline: Software Engineer @ ServiceTitan | Ex-AWS
profile.summary: Passionate software engineer with experience delivering numerous high impact projects across multiple roles and internships in the industry, with a history of working in environments which demand stellar interpersonal and leadership skills. Experienced with fast-paced Agile development working on cloud serverless systems, proficient in a wide array of programming languages, and eager to learn with an open mind. Responsible team player who emphasizes good mentorship and community-building with a Bachelor's degree focused in Computer Engineering from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
AWS Lambda

• Created observability infrastructure to monitor Lambda services and trigger automatic rollbacks on problematic deployments. Wrote accompanying runbooks to debug service issues.

• Improved existing observability infrastructure code to easily support team-specific alarms.

• Decoupled core Lambda services for automated AWS region builds by designing and implementing service-specific integration testing infrastructure. Worked with multiple teams to implement deliverables, drive adoption, and handle long-term ownership.

• Mitigated customer impact during time-critical on-call events regarding fraudulent/abuse activity, pipeline health, customer account quotas, etc. while identifying and reporting root causes for issues involving Lambda’s high performance, large scale distributed systems.

• Updated vital account blocking tools to block 50% more fraudulent accounts by adding support for Lambda's cell-based architecture.

• Redesigned the existing Lambda core control plane service and AWS Service Quotas integration microservice to use a generic pub-sub system which allows all Lambda subservices to listen to service events and decouple them from the Lambda core control plane for region build automation.

• Mentored and onboarded 3 new software engineers in Lambda.
positions.insights: Skills: Serverless Computing · Distributed Systems · Cloud Applications · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Quality Engineer
positions.description: • Utilized software testing skills including Cucumber and TestNG to develop/present Maven project to managers.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented Python script which retrieves, filters, and processes data from StockX REST API in order to calculate and update average market prices of company inventory stored in MySQL.

• Eliminate abuse of new user welcome deals by adding a phone number verification script upon new account creation utilizing NumVerify JSON API.

positions.title: Resident Advisor
positions.description:
• Engaged in quarterly 1:1’s with 50+ residents and hosted events each semester to create a close-knit community.

• De-escalated and remedied emergencies, occasionally involving emergency services, through clear communication.

positions.title: Enterprise Technology Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: • Exceeded the number of expected deliverables for an internal video messaging web app project by implementing a multi-page app utilizing React.js and WebRTC API to handle user data entry and ability to record/playback webcam footage and audio.

positions.title: Child/Youth Activity Center
positions.description: • Supervised the child/youth activity center facilities to ensure the safety and entertainment of the children.

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Worked as a team with other board members to plan and supervise procedures and activities. 
• Increased the funds and participation in 2016-2017 exponentially from previous years by employing great teamwork skills with others in coordinating many fun and engaging activities.
•Played countless pieces on the cello in the Kaiser Permanente front lobby to radiate a positive and soothing environment for patients, doctors, and co-workers alike.

projects.title: COVID-19 Tracker
projects.description: • Queries a COVID-19 database for updated information and statistics on COVID-19 and utilizes the Gmail RESTful API to send an email responding to a user's intent (i.e., the total number of cases in a given state).

projects.title: Semantic Image Segmentation and Object Detection with Neural Networks Paper
projects.description: • Compared and contrasted fully convolutional networks, Atrous convolution, YOLO9000, and MobileNetV2 systems described by four different papers from IEEE Conferences on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CCVP).
